name: 이로리(바닥 화로, 숯불 + 걸린 무쇠 주전자)
label: sengoku-edo/se-irori

answer.main_body: sunken hearth (irori) wooden frame with ash pit
answer.evidence: The irori hearth has a clear top-down view showing the inside of the square basin/ash pit (rows 23–36, 14 rows tall) containing charcoal, with the back rim of the frame visible across rows 19–22 (4 rows tall).

answer.main_body: sunken hearth (irori) with ash pit and hanging kettle
answer.evidence: The sunken hearth is viewed from above showing the ash pit interior (rows 23-35, 13 rows tall) with burning charcoal and embers, surrounded by a wooden frame, beneath a suspended kettle.

answer.main_body: sunken floor hearth (irori) with ash pit and hanging kettle
answer.evidence: The hearth shows a full view from above into the sunken ash pit (opening_rows = 12, rows 24-35) containing charcoal and embers, with the enclosing wooden frame clearly visible around it.

answer.main_body: sunken hearth frame and ash pit (irori)
answer.evidence: The hearth clearly shows the interior ash pit and embers seen from above (13 rows tall) with the hanging kettle and charcoal visible inside. It is properly depicted in 3/4 top-down perspective, not a front elevation.
